final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now splits accented letters into base letter plus accent mark, drops the marks, and then calls slugify.

I left `vendor/slugify/index.js` alone because its header says not to edit it by hand. Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) use the same vendored slugify, so they still drop accented letters. If you want the same behavior there, say so.
